notes:
PASS: every gate G1-G9 passed on the fake backend with no warnings; the last gate printed the digest above. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card is family-config with helper SerialDriver, but the upstream does not put ASCII command words on the wire. The host builds an 8-byte payload from a binary command id and an integer (software/common/gui/main_window.py:1220-1235) and SerialThread prefixes 0x02 and appends a CRC-8-CCITT byte (software/common/hardware/serial_thread.py:375-383). A SerialDriver command table cannot reproduce that framing, so the package is a direct Driver over hardware.serial_thread:SerialThread with native.py; a maintainer can correct the card with an override. COVERAGE: reads of X/Y position in um, raw Z microsteps and the moving flag from the 24-byte position broadcast (firmware/octoaxes/serial.cpp:139-164) plus the last commanded illumination port and percentage (the upstream GUI keeps the same software mirror because the firmware has no readback). Actions: absolute X/Y moves with MOVETO_X/MOVETO_Y, the catalogued illumination write with SET_PORT_ILLUMINATION, and a no-input safe-state action. E-stop: SET_AXIS_DISABLE_ENABLE 32 de-energises X/Y/Z/W/Turret and TURN_OFF_ALL_PORTS 39 turns the light off. NOT COVERED: Z, W and Turret motion, homing, autofocus, hardware triggering and firmware version queries. Z is read as raw microsteps, not um, because the screw pitch depends on the Z_AXIS_VARIANT software switch (software/octoaxes/constants.py:16), so converting it would assume one of two configurations. FAKE: the fake is an in-memory behavioral stand-in, not a transcript; the device's 24-byte frames are periodic state broadcasts plus command acknowledgements, not a request/response transcript, and the starting positions and port values are placeholders. The fake implements only public methods that exist on SerialThread (send_binary_command, is_connected, get_status, stop), and G7 passed. HARDWARE: native.py wraps SerialThread and was never imported, instantiated or run; no hardware run is claimed. The package is model-authored and unreviewed (reviewed_by is null); the loader's unreviewed-model refusal covers R2/R3 only and this package is R1, so this driver claims no such protection. REFERENCE NOTE: the generated effective limit table prints the class's identical 0-100 percent illumination bound as class_default; driver.py declares the same bound with source upstream_code and ref software/common/gui/widgets.py:891, and G4 passed with no REF_VALUE or REF_BINARY warning. The upstream repository has no text licence statement beyond README.md:283 (MIT), but the card pins license_spdx NOASSERTION and the lock matches the card; no licence class claim is made.
